name: eu_funding-mcp
description: EU Funding & Tenders Portal (deals): me, search_postings, get_posting. Every tool maps to a document

tools.name: me
tools.description: Public SEDIA search with the open/forthcoming filter, one result: checks the API is reachable (no credentials; the public apiKey is SEDIA).

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: POST /search?apiKey=SEDIA&text=… with the documented 'query' form part (typed application/json) restricting to tenders (type 0), call topics (1, 2) and cascade-funding calls (8) whose status is forthcoming (31094501) or open (31094502), English records only (languages part). `query` is required by the API — pass *** for everything. Ids are topic/tender identifiers (e.g. HORIZON-CL4-2024-DIGITAL-EMERGING-01-22). `category`/`min_budget` are not applied; the status in the index can lag the topic page.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: Topic Details service: search with text="<identifier>" (quoted, as documented) limited to tenders and calls in English; returns the best match's metadata (description HTML, deadline, call, budget overview JSON string, conditions under raw.metadata).
